geographicReview.notes: Approximate native fit at [103.860485341,1.287468009], heading1.497794301143; +X roughly north and pods to the bay-facing west. Standard Protomaps/Mapzen and ordinary photographs establish fit. Reservoir water/pier-cap zero and6m endpoint deck levels are provisional, not surveyed elevations. A249-point body/pod replacement outline removes only overlapping mapped paths; the57-sample curved deck profile aligns the retained side connector. The earlier ignored review reader halved terrain elevations; this review re-reads the original archive at its correct scale (center28.3448m matches the28.3448407m independent decoder sample). Bounded walkway/pod and direct-approach ground openings keep coarse ground/shoreline walls out of the structure without editing DEM samples or native water. Three immediate mesh joins meet the authored deck within0.02m. This proves internal consistency, not geodetic accuracy. The outer side-link/cycleway junction, native shore morphology, generic approach grades/widths and neighboring procedural bridge heights remain coarse approximations, outside the scoped bridge exterior. High, steep coarse bank walls remain beside the narrow landings; this is not a polished street-level waterfront reconstruction.

runtimePreservation.notes: All 191 resident / 336 wider mapped buildings, 1131 independent transportation records, correctly decoded original DEM samples and native water remain. Bayfront Avenue road bridge (two lane records) and the independent Marina Promenade cycleway (one through record) retain exact geometry plans and hints. Bounded ground/bank openings deliberately alter only the rendered terrain beneath the model and direct approach strips; outside ground probes remain exact and all ground/bank geometry restores on unload. Native shoreline walls now respect model ground openings while retaining water. Failed load keeps original native content without supports. Fixture/engine hashes are pinned.56 targeted Earth ground/placement/connector tests,24 shoreline/ground/semantic tests, affected package typechecks and changed-file formatter checks passed. Full engine CI was not rerun; earlier livery-schema failures remain recorded.

limitations: Exterior reconstruction, not fabrication geometry. Spans total285m in the source although narrative length is280m; mapped curve is used for fit.
Helix phase and pitch, small rods, canopy panel boundaries and joint hardware are reconstructed from primary photographs.
Local reservoir water/pier-cap elevation is provisionally0m in the viewer. Geographic approval requires rendered fit; no survey datum is claimed.
Adjacent vehicular Bayfront bridge, city promenade, interior foundation piles and dynamic lighting control are outside this asset.
The original detailed master remains reproducible through the unchanged default recipe. Current detailed and browser models correct the pod/pier stations while retaining the full detailed geometry.

Skyline uses four representative counter-rotating helical ribbons. District retains all eleven source strands as crossed ribbons; near levels use six/twelve-sided tubes. Narrow collars, paving relief and small secondary hardware stay in the master.
Near glass rails and leaf canopies remain open and transparent. Rail posts use6m/1.5m spacing; brace/collar rhythms are explicitly reduced from the master.
Ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles/Mapzen establish approximate fit, not a reservoir/engineering survey. Physical device timings remain pending.
Pod footprints suppress their original map connector paths. Retained side links use the authored curved deck profile; adjacent Bayfront road-bridge height remains a procedural approximation.

Current phases interpolate smoothly around the mapped pod stations to keep the access thresholds clear. The untouched default master recipe retains its original constant phases. Exact fabrication profiles and structural analysis remain outside the asset.

Standard coarse urban terrain overstates the local shore heights. Exact model-owned walkway/pod/approach ground openings keep the bridge visible without editing elevation samples or water. The outer side-link/cycleway junction and generic approach grades remain coarse reconstructions; only the three immediate model joins are height-verified.
